description: Key actors, taken in chronological order by when they act; each life graphed in full (curator, 2026-10-13; 25-LIVES-AND-PLAYGROUND.md §13). A start, not a limit: people the agents surface join as they surface. Each Wikidata identity was checked at Wikidata on 2026-10-14 (English label and description, instance of human Q5); the label here is the curator's name for the actor, and the Wikidata wording stays on the AuthorityRecord. Per actor: the first-contact harvest and its budgeted expansion, the structure enrichers for the offices and forces the life touches, the agent's source plan, then the reader.
